constructorArgs: <MockUSDC address — to be filled at deploy time>

compilerSettings.note: Optimizer MUST be enabled (runs=200) — without it the contract is ~39KB which exceeds the 24KB Spurious Dragon limit. With optimizer enabled it compiles to ~22.6KB (deployable).

postDeploySteps: 1. Deploy MockUSDC (or use the existing Arc Testnet MockUSDC at 0x334D14E7E39e1f02a60fc1169CdF7b0BEDE30dEb).
3. fund the reserveVault (deployer by default) with USDC collateral for redemptions.
4. setGenesisReserve(g) if a dedicated genesis holder is desired.
5. genesisMint(amount) — one-shot, mints locked MTQ to the genesis reserve.
6. setReserveVault(v) — point to the actual Reserve Vault multisig.
7. setAssetRegistry(registry) — wire the §5 asset admission registry.
8. setOracleAdapter(0, chainlinkAdapter), setOracleAdapter(1, pythAdapter), setOracleAdapter(2, chronicleAdapter) — wire the §9 multi-source oracle adapters.
9. grantRole(KEEPER_ROLE, keeperMultisig) — wire the MARP keeper / risk-state machine operator.
10. grantRole(ORACLE_ROLE, oracleMultisig) — wire the oracle committee (if different from keeper).
11. grantRole(PAUSER_ROLE, pauserMultisig) — wire the emergency pauser.
12. grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, daoTimelock) — wire the §14.2 DAO/multi-sig governance (recommended: transfer ADMIN_ROLE to a Safe / timelock contract and renounce deployer's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE).
13. bootstrapReserveHoldings([usdHeld, eurHeld, jpyHeld, gbpHeld, cnyHeld, chfHeld, goldHeld]) — initialize the on-chain reserve mirror (1e18 USD per component).
14. commitWeights(target[7], smoothed[7], execution[7]) — first MASE weight commit (oracle/keeper); each weight must be within its admissibility envelope.
15. Once adapters are wired, commitFxRatesFromOracles() can replace setFxRates() as the live-FX path.
